narrow_primary_source_proposition: The Union had not fully demonstrated the source, time and method by which the 2008 Entitlement Rules were brought into force to repeal or supersede the 1982 Rules.
critical_scope_caveat: Do not infer from this observation alone that every clause of the 2008 document is void or inapplicable

narrow_primary_source_proposition: The Court compares the 1982 rule-5 presumption of health on entry with 2008 rule-5 wording requiring a causal connection rather than treating disease onset alone as conclusive.
critical_scope_caveat: Must be read with paragraphs 22–29 and final operative paragraph 39

narrow_primary_source_proposition: The Court describes rule 9 of the 1982 Entitlement Rules and rule 7 of the 2008 scheme as broadly carrying forward the ordinary onus on the employer, subject to qualification.
critical_scope_caveat: Do not generalise this presumption to schemes or discharges outside the judgment's scope

narrow_primary_source_proposition: The 2008 rule-7 discussion recognises a narrow exception concerning claims made after 15 years following discharge, retirement, invalidment or release.
critical_scope_caveat: Apply only after identifying actual claim date and operative scheme

narrow_primary_source_proposition: Medical Board opinions deserve due weight, but tribunals must scrutinise their reasons; courts should not substitute a different view merely because it is possible.
critical_scope_caveat: Not a rule of absolute medical-board finality; read full reasons

narrow_primary_source_proposition: The Union's present appeals were dismissed; for claims brought to the relevant forum after 15 years, the Court directed a shift in onus to the claimant under rule 7 of the 2008 Entitlement Rules.
critical_scope_caveat: Case-specific final order and procedural delay question remain distinct from general entitlement principles
